headline: Apply 2-3 drops after cleansing & toning
subhead: Let the serum absorb fully into the skin before the next step of your routine.
footnote: 4 out of 5 stars from 1,491 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Left column: large strength figure and active name, then headline, subhead and up to three proof points; the AI-generated person photo (person_prompt) fills the rounded card in the right-hand zone and carries the AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; the real pack shot stands large in front of the photo on a soft plinth (lower left of the card); rating line in the footnote band, CTA "Shop now" bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a matte off-white tiled wall above a narrow stone shelf, soft daylight from the upper left, one folded plain white towel at the far left edge only. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit, reserved for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left 50% calm and low-detail, reserved for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: human usage. Copy is the page's usage only: 2-3 drops after cleansing & toning, let it absorb before the next step (F13), AM & PM (F14); the formulation line is the first sentence of F3. Kept: usage told as a short sequence (Foxtale), hands-on moment of use as the visual cue (Chemist at Play). Dropped: the timed-fix headline, '#1 daily duo', de-tan/brighten promises, and the page's sebum, pore, barrier, melanin and 'clinically proven' wording (F3 second half, F6, F7, F8, F16-F18). The person is AI-generated (High risk, labelled); a real application photo would lower the risk. Rating in the footnote slot.

blend_sources.took: usage told as a short sequence (what to do, in what order)
hands-on moment of use as the visual cue

person_prompt: An Indian man in his mid 20s with medium-brown skin, just after a gym session, standing at a bright bathroom mirror, framed from the chest up in a plain sleeveless training vest with a small towel around his neck and his hair slightly damp. His fingertips are pressed lightly against his cheek as if pressing in a few drops (nothing visible on his fingers or face), his other hand holding the end of the towel, his expression calm. Soft daylight from the upper left, an off-white tiled wall behind him, medium close-up, shallow depth of field, framed so he sits slightly left of centre with calm space to his right. Natural, unretouched medium-brown skin with visible pores and ordinary variation in tone, true to life, nothing implying a skin result. No product, bottle, dropper, tube, jar or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.
